title: AI-Powered Commercial Insurance Startup Announces The Largest Publicly Disclosed Series A Amount Raised By A Black Founder (AfroTech)
notes: AfroTech, 2026. Harper = 'largest publicly disclosed Series A amount raised by a Black founder.' CEO Dakotah Rice (Black), rural Alabama; Brown, Goldman, Coatue, Carlyle, HBS dropout. Co-founder/CTO Tushar Nair. $47M combined Seed+Series A (Feb 2026), led by Emergence Capital; YC, Peak XV, Antler, 10X Founders, Fellows Fund, Outset.
